summary: DestProfilePlcCpMaximum is a .NET Web UserControl that supports viewing and updating a destination profile's maximum learner information. It includes editable forms, popups, validation, and session handling, and interacts with backend data sources and user sessions.
purpose: To allow users to view, edit, and update maximum learner profile data for a destination in a web application, supporting session-specific editing and data retrieval.

workflows.name: View/Edit Destination Profile Maximum
steps: System checks session validity; cancels operation if session missing.
Profile data is loaded using DestID and SessionAgencyID.
User can trigger Edit via cmdEdit button.
System switches uxDetail form to edit mode and shows modal popup.
User interacts with editable fields; save button becomes visible if screen is editable.
On update/insert, command name and mode are set.
After ItemUpdated, session is cached and redirected to CurrentPage.

workflows.name: Glossary Help Access
steps: User clicks GlossaryLink in either view or edit form.
System opens a help popup with MaxLearners context using session query string.

business_rules: Profile data cannot be selected unless user session is present.
Edit mode only enabled if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Grid edit mode and modal popup shown only for edit command.
Glossary help links always use session query string.
validations: Edit/insert mode disables edit fields if ScreenIsEditable is false.
conditions: UserSession must be present for selection.
ScreenIsEditable must be true for edit mode.
uxDetail current mode dictates command (Update or Insert).
system_behavior: Redirects user to CurrentPage after profile update.
Disables edit fields if screen not editable.
dependencies: Grid utility for switching modes and showing details.
exceptions: Selection cancelled if user session is missing.
Edit/save not available if ScreenIsEditable is false.
content_gaps: Field-level business rules and data validation for maximum learner value not explicitly described.

Underlying data schema for destination profile is not included.
UI layout and possible error-handling scenarios are minimally described.
